svg.title: MUSE — ER Diagram (16 core entities)
svg.text: 16 of the 64 tables, with ALL their columns and the 24 real foreign keys between them. "→ table" marks a foreign key to a table not drawn here.
Simplified view for submission: the database is unchanged; each of the other 48 tables belongs to one of these 16 (see MUSE_ERD_Core_GUIDE.md). Complete schema: MUSE_ERD_Full_Schema.

g.title: lg_notes
g.text: Crow's foot = many · bar = one · circle = zero (optional)
Solid line: identifying (FK is part of the child's PK)
PK primary key · FK foreign key
UK, U1, U2: unique key (same tag = one composite key)
